<style>
.chat-module-launcher{display:grid;place-items:center;min-height:260px;padding:24px;text-align:center}
.chat-module-launcher .chat-module-card{max-width:560px;padding:22px;border:1px solid var(--pda-line,#d8ddd8);border-radius:16px;background:#fff}
.pda-chat-dock{position:fixed;right:18px;bottom:18px;z-index:1250;font-family:var(--pda-body,inherit)}
.pda-chat-launcher{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;min-height:48px;padding:0 16px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.38);border-radius:999px;background:#0d6674;color:#fff;box-shadow:0 12px 32px rgba(7,46,57,.28);font-weight:850;cursor:pointer}
.pda-chat-launcher:hover{transform:translateY(-1px)}
.pda-chat-launcher-icon{display:grid;place-items:center;width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.14);font-size:15px}
.pda-chat-launcher-badge{display:grid;place-items:center;min-width:20px;height:20px;padding:0 5px;border-radius:999px;background:#e85749;color:#fff;font-size:10px;font-weight:900}
.pda-chat-launcher-badge[hidden]{display:none}
.pda-chat-panel{display:grid;grid-template-rows:auto auto minmax(0,1fr) auto;width:min(410px,calc(100vw - 24px));height:min(620px,calc(100vh - 88px));overflow:hidden;border:1px solid #cfdad7;border-radius:18px;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 24px 70px rgba(3,35,45,.30)}
.pda-chat-dock.is-minimized .pda-chat-panel{display:none}
.pda-chat-dock:not(.is-minimized) .pda-chat-launcher{display:none}
.pda-chat-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;padding:12px 13px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0c6270,#0d7b86);color:#fff}
.pda-chat-head-copy{display:grid;gap:1px;min-width:0}
.pda-chat-head strong{font-size:12px}
.pda-chat-head small{font-size:7.5px;opacity:.82}
.pda-chat-head-actions{display:flex;gap:5px}
.pda-chat-head-actions button{min-width:32px;height:32px;padding:0 8px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.28);border-radius:9px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.10);color:#fff;cursor:pointer}
.pda-chat-channelbar{display:flex;gap:5px;overflow-x:auto;padding:7px 8px;border-bottom:1px solid #dde5e2;background:#f4f7f5}
.pda-chat-channel{flex:0 0 auto;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;max-width:170px;padding:6px 8px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:9px;background:transparent;color:#31535c;font-size:8px;font-weight:800;white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer}
.pda-chat-channel.active{border-color:#b8d8d2;background:#e5f1ee;color:#0b5f6c}
.pda-chat-channel .unread{display:grid;place-items:center;min-width:17px;height:17px;padding:0 4px;border-radius:999px;background:#d95b4c;color:#fff;font-size:7px}
.pda-chat-messages{display:grid;align-content:start;gap:8px;overflow:auto;padding:11px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fbfaf7,#eef3f0)}
.pda-chat-message{display:grid;gap:3px;max-width:84%;padding:8px 9px;border:1px solid #d8e1dd;border-radius:11px 11px 11px 4px;background:#fff}
.pda-chat-message.mine{justify-self:end;border-color:#b4d8d0;border-radius:11px 11px 4px 11px;background:#e6f3ef}
.pda-chat-message-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
.pda-chat-message-head strong{font-size:7.5px}.pda-chat-message-head time{font-size:6.5px;color:#7c8b87}
.pda-chat-message-body{font-size:8.5px;line-height:1.4;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.pda-chat-empty{display:grid;place-items:center;min-height:220px;padding:28px;text-align:center;color:#74847f;font-size:9px}
.pda-chat-compose{display:grid;gap:6px;padding:8px;border-top:1px solid #dce4e1;background:#fff}
.pda-chat-compose .pda-rich-toolbar{gap:3px;padding:4px}
.pda-chat-compose .pda-rich-toolbar button{min-height:26px;padding:3px 6px;font-size:7px}
.pda-chat-compose .pda-rich-body{min-height:54px;max-height:110px;overflow:auto;padding:8px;font-size:9px}
.pda-chat-compose-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px}
.pda-chat-compose-hint{font-size:7px;color:#7b8985}
.pda-chat-send{min-height:32px;padding:0 14px;border:0;border-radius:9px;background:#0d6f7a;color:#fff;font-weight:850;cursor:pointer}
.pda-chat-create{width:min(560px,94vw);border:0;border-radius:14px;padding:16px;box-shadow:0 22px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.25)}
.pda-chat-create::backdrop{background:rgba(3,32,42,.48)}
.pda-chat-create form{display:grid;gap:10px}
.pda-chat-members{display:grid;max-height:280px;overflow:auto;gap:4px}
.pda-chat-member{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;padding:7px;border-radius:8px;background:#f3f5f2;font-size:8px}
@media(max-width:620px){
 .pda-chat-dock{right:8px;bottom:8px}
 .pda-chat-panel{width:calc(100vw - 16px);height:min(680px,calc(100vh - 74px));border-radius:15px}
 .pda-chat-launcher{min-height:44px}
}
</style>

<script>
if(!window.PDA_CHAT_WIDGET){
 window.PDA_CHAT_WIDGET=(()=>{
  const {el,button,call,status,richEditor}=App;
  const state={
    bootstrap:null,
    channel:null,
    messages:[],
    dock:null,
    launcher:null,
    badge:null,
    panel:null,
    channelbar:null,
    messagesBox:null,
    title:null,
    meta:null,
    editor:null,
    send:null,
    timer:null,
    loading:false,
    open:false
  };
  const me=()=>String(App.state.boot?.email||App.state.boot?.usuario?.email||'').toLowerCase();

  function unreadTotal(){
    return (state.bootstrap?.canais||[]).reduce((sum,c)=>sum+Number(c.naoLidas||c.nao_lidas||0),0);
  }

  function updateUnread(){
    if(!state.badge)return;
    const total=unreadTotal();
    state.badge.textContent=total>99?'99+':String(total);
    state.badge.hidden=!total;
    if(state.launcher){
      state.launcher.title=total?('Chat CIDIJUS · '+total+' mensagem(ns) não lida(s)'):'Chat CIDIJUS';
    }
  }

  function channelName(c){return c?.nome||'Conversa';}

  function renderChannels(){
    if(!state.channelbar)return;
    state.channelbar.replaceChildren();
    const list=state.bootstrap?.canais||[];
    if(!list.length){
      state.channelbar.append(el('span','Nenhuma conversa disponível.','hint'));
      return;
    }
    list.forEach(c=>{
      const b=el('button',undefined,'pda-chat-channel'+(state.channel?.id===c.id?' active':''));
      b.type='button';
      const unread=Number(c.naoLidas||c.nao_lidas||0);
      b.append(el('span',channelName(c)));
      if(unread)b.append(el('span',unread>99?'99+':String(unread),'unread'));
      b.onclick=()=>selectChannel(c).catch(err=>status(err.message||String(err),true));
      state.channelbar.append(b);
    });
  }

  function renderMessages(){
    if(!state.messagesBox)return;
    state.messagesBox.replaceChildren();
    if(!state.channel){
      state.messagesBox.append(el('div','Selecione uma conversa para começar.','pda-chat-empty'));
      return;
    }
    if(!state.messages.length){
      state.messagesBox.append(el('div','Ainda não há mensagens nesta conversa.','pda-chat-empty'));
      return;
    }
    state.messages.forEach(m=>{
      const mine=String(m.autor||'').toLowerCase()===me();
      const row=el('article',undefined,'pda-chat-message'+(mine?' mine':''));
      const head=el('div',undefined,'pda-chat-message-head');
      head.append(
        el('strong',m.autorNome||m.autor||'Usuário'),
        el('time',new Date(m.criadoEm).toLocaleString('pt-BR',{day:'2-digit',month:'2-digit',hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'}))
      );
      const body=el('div',undefined,'pda-chat-message-body');
      body.innerHTML=m.conteudo||'';
      row.append(head,body);
      state.messagesBox.append(row);
    });
    state.messagesBox.scrollTop=state.messagesBox.scrollHeight;
  }

  async function refreshMessages(silent=true){
    if(!state.channel)return;
    const id=state.channel.id;
    const data=await call('chatMensagens',{canalId:id,limit:120},false,{noLoader:silent});
    if(!state.channel||state.channel.id!==id)return;
    state.messages=data.mensagens||[];
    renderMessages();
    if(state.open){
      state.channel.naoLidas=0;
      state.channel.nao_lidas=0;
      renderChannels();
      updateUnread();
      call('chatMarcarLido',{canalId:id},true,{silent:true}).catch(()=>{});
    }
  }

  async function selectChannel(c){
    state.channel=c;
    state.title.textContent=channelName(c);
    state.meta.textContent=c.tipo==='SISTEMA'?'Canal geral do CIDIJUS':'Conversa interna';
    renderChannels();
    await refreshMessages(false);
    state.editor?.focus();
  }

  async function loadBootstrap(silent=true){
    if(state.loading)return;
    state.loading=true;
    try{
      const previous=state.channel?.id||'';
      const data=await call('chat',{},false,{noLoader:silent});
      state.bootstrap=data||{canais:[],usuarios:[]};
      const list=state.bootstrap.canais||[];
      state.channel=list.find(c=>c.id===previous)||list[0]||null;
      if(state.channel){
        state.title.textContent=channelName(state.channel);
        state.meta.textContent=state.channel.tipo==='SISTEMA'?'Canal geral do CIDIJUS':'Conversa interna';
      }else{
        state.title.textContent='Chat CIDIJUS';
        state.meta.textContent='Comunicação interna';
      }
      renderChannels();
      updateUnread();
      if(state.open&&state.channel)await refreshMessages(true);
      else if(!state.channel){
        state.messages=[];
        renderMessages();
      }
    }finally{
      state.loading=false;
    }
  }

  async function sendMessage(){
    if(!state.channel){
      status('Selecione uma conversa.',true);
      return;
    }
    if(!state.editor.getText().trim())return;
    state.send.disabled=true;
    try{
      await call('chatEnviar',{canalId:state.channel.id,conteudo:state.editor.getHtml()},true,{silent:true});
      state.editor.setHtml('');
      await refreshMessages(true);
      await loadBootstrap(true);
    }finally{
      state.send.disabled=false;
    }
  }

  function openCreate(){
    const dialog=el('dialog',undefined,'pda-chat-create');
    const form=el('form');
    const title=el('h3','Nova conversa');
    const name=el('input');
    name.placeholder='Nome da conversa';
    name.required=true;
    name.maxLength=120;
    const memberBox=el('div',undefined,'pda-chat-members');
    const picked=new Set();
    (state.bootstrap?.usuarios||[]).forEach(u=>{
      if(String(u.email||'').toLowerCase()===me())return;
      const label=el('label',undefined,'pda-chat-member');
      const check=el('input');
      check.type='checkbox';
      check.onchange=()=>check.checked?picked.add(u.email):picked.delete(u.email);
      label.append(check,el('span',(u.nome||u.nomeUsuario||u.email)+(u.funcao?' · '+u.funcao:'')));
      memberBox.append(label);
    });
    const actions=el('div',undefined,'actions');
    actions.append(button('Cancelar',()=>dialog.close(),true));
    const save=el('button','Criar conversa');
    save.type='submit';
    actions.append(save);
    form.append(title,name,el('p','Selecione os membros do CIDIJUS.','hint'),memberBox,actions);
    form.onsubmit=async ev=>{
      ev.preventDefault();
      save.disabled=true;
      try{
        const result=await call('chatCriar',{nome:name.value,membros:[...picked],tipo:'GRUPO'},true,{silent:true});
        dialog.close();
        await loadBootstrap(false);
        const found=(state.bootstrap?.canais||[]).find(c=>c.id===result.canal.id);
        if(found)await selectChannel(found);
      }finally{
        save.disabled=false;
      }
    };
    dialog.append(form);
    document.body.append(dialog);
    dialog.addEventListener('close',()=>dialog.remove(),{once:true});
    dialog.showModal();
    name.focus();
  }

  function setOpen(open){
    ensureDom();
    state.open=!!open;
    state.dock.classList.toggle('is-minimized',!state.open);
    state.panel.setAttribute('aria-hidden',state.open?'false':'true');
    if(state.open){
      loadBootstrap(false).catch(err=>status(err.message||String(err),true));
      setTimeout(()=>state.editor?.focus(),40);
    }
  }

  function ensureDom(){
    if(state.dock&&state.dock.isConnected)return;
    const dock=el('div',undefined,'pda-chat-dock is-minimized');
    dock.id='pdaChatDock';

    const launcher=el('button',undefined,'pda-chat-launcher');
    launcher.type='button';
    const badge=el('span','0','pda-chat-launcher-badge');
    badge.hidden=true;
    launcher.append(
      el('span','◌','pda-chat-launcher-icon'),
      el('span','Chat CIDIJUS'),
      badge
    );
    launcher.onclick=()=>setOpen(true);

    const panel=el('section',undefined,'pda-chat-panel');
    panel.setAttribute('aria-label','Chat CIDIJUS');
    panel.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');

    const head=el('header',undefined,'pda-chat-head');
    const headCopy=el('div',undefined,'pda-chat-head-copy');
    const title=el('strong','Chat CIDIJUS');
    const meta=el('small','Comunicação interna');
    headCopy.append(title,meta);
    const headActions=el('div',undefined,'pda-chat-head-actions');
    const create=el('button','+');
    create.type='button';
    create.title='Nova conversa';
    create.onclick=openCreate;
    const minimize=el('button','—');
    minimize.type='button';
    minimize.title='Minimizar chat';
    minimize.onclick=()=>setOpen(false);
    headActions.append(create,minimize);
    head.append(headCopy,headActions);

    const channelbar=el('div',undefined,'pda-chat-channelbar');
    const messagesBox=el('div',undefined,'pda-chat-messages');

    const compose=el('div',undefined,'pda-chat-compose');
    const editor=richEditor('','Escreva uma mensagem…');
    const composeActions=el('div',undefined,'pda-chat-compose-actions');
    composeActions.append(
      el('span','Enter não envia; use o botão para evitar mensagens acidentais.','pda-chat-compose-hint')
    );
    const send=el('button','Enviar','pda-chat-send');
    send.type='button';
    send.onclick=()=>sendMessage().catch(err=>status(err.message||String(err),true));
    composeActions.append(send);
    compose.append(editor.root,composeActions);

    panel.append(head,channelbar,messagesBox,compose);
    dock.append(launcher,panel);
    document.body.append(dock);

    Object.assign(state,{dock,launcher,badge,panel,channelbar,messagesBox,title,meta,editor,send});
    renderMessages();

    if(!state.timer){
      state.timer=setInterval(()=>loadBootstrap(true).catch(()=>{}),15000);
    }
  }

  async function ensure(options={}){
    ensureDom();
    if(options.open===true)setOpen(true);
    else if(options.open===false&&state.open===false)state.dock.classList.add('is-minimized');
    await loadBootstrap(true);
    return api;
  }

  const api={
    ensure,
    open:()=>setOpen(true),
    minimize:()=>setOpen(false),
    refresh:()=>loadBootstrap(false),
    get unread(){return unreadTotal();}
  };
  return api;
 })();
}

window.PDA_MODULES.CHAT=async ctx=>{
 const {el}=App;
 ctx.root.replaceChildren();
 const card=el('div',undefined,'chat-module-card');
 card.append(
   el('h2','Chat CIDIJUS'),
   el('p','O chat agora funciona como uma janela flutuante e permanece disponível enquanto você navega pelos demais módulos.','hint')
 );
 const open=el('button','Abrir chat');
 open.type='button';
 open.onclick=()=>window.PDA_CHAT_WIDGET.open();
 card.append(open);
 ctx.root.append(card);
 await window.PDA_CHAT_WIDGET.ensure({open:true});
};
</script>
